templates.title: Brad VPS - Secure Web App
templates.description: Reusable HTTPS-only web application for the Brad VPS. Routes through Traefik on the external proxy network and applies the existing CrowdSec and Authentik forward-auth middlewares.

env.name: APP_NAME
env.label: Application name
env.description: Unique name used for the Traefik router and service.

env.name: APP_PORT
env.label: Application port
env.description: HTTP port listened to by the container.

templates.title: Brad VPS - Secure Web App + Storage
templates.description: HTTPS-only web application with configurable persistent storage. Routes through Traefik on the external proxy network and applies the existing CrowdSec and Authentik forward-auth middlewares.

env.name: APP_NAME
env.label: Application name
env.description: Unique name used for the Traefik router and service.

env.name: APP_PORT
env.label: Application port
env.description: HTTP port listened to by the container.

env.name: APP_DATA
env.label: Application data source
env.description: Host path or named volume source for persistent application data.

env.name: APP_DATA_PATH
env.label: Application data path
env.description: Container path where application data is mounted.

templates.title: Brad VPS - Internal Container
templates.description: Minimal private container for background jobs and internal services. It has no public Traefik route and publishes no host ports.

env.name: APP_NAME
env.label: Application name
env.description: Name used to identify this application in the Compose project.

env.name: APP_IMAGE
env.label: Docker image
env.description: Docker image for the internal container.
